description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes related to repository settings in a version control system, likely Git. It includes configuration options, default initializations, and accessor functions for repository-related parameters.

methods.name: prepare_repo_settings
methods.description: Prepares or initializes repository settings for a given repository object.

methods.name: repo_settings_clear
methods.description: Clears or resets repository settings for a given repository object.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_log_all_ref_updates
methods.description: Retrieves the setting for logging all reference updates in the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_warn_ambiguous_refs
methods.description: Retrieves the warning setting for ambiguous references in the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_hooks_path
methods.description: Gets the hooks path configured for the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_get_big_file_threshold
methods.description: Gets the threshold size for big files in the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_set_big_file_threshold
methods.description: Sets the threshold size for big files in the repository.

methods.name: repo_settings_reset_shared_repository
methods.description: Resets the shared repository setting to default.
